cost.convention: Full factors include all-N fixed-active setup; reduced factors include exact complementary Schur solves and active rational evaluation. RHS counts are actual complex columns, not LU-equivalent estimates.

rows.metric_boundary: best@K and archive-best-by-time are offline oracle coverage; top1 uses stored online all-data residual ranking; all returned roots are not necessarily data accepted; no scorer feedback to frozen predictions
